entities.summary: Louis Ferdinand, Prince of Prussia was a grandson of Kaiser Wilhelm II and member of the House of Hohenzollern, which occupied the Prussian and German thrones until the abolition of those monarchies in 1918. He was also noteworthy as a businessman and patron of the arts.
